tools.name: search_glossary
tools.description: Search the Generative AI Maturity Framework glossary of 100 curated AI / GenAI / agentic-AI terms. Returns matching terms with definitions and canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_dimension
tools.description: Get one of the six Generative AI Maturity Framework dimensions with full editorial content — definition, signals, per-level signals, common blockers, how to move up, related standards.

tools.name: get_maturity_level
tools.description: Get one of the six maturity levels (1-6) with editorial content — hook, organizational reality, cross-dimension summary, common blockers to next level, worked industry example.

tools.name: get_framework_spec
tools.description: Return the full canonical machine-readable framework spec — six dimensions, six levels, scoring scale, assessment types, endpoints. CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: list_comparisons
tools.description: List all head-to-head "X vs Y" comparison pages on the framework site — agentic-vs-traditional, MCP-vs-REST, LangGraph vs CrewAI vs AutoGen, vector databases, frontier LLMs, and more. Returns titles, summaries, and canonical URLs.

tools.name: list_whitepapers
tools.description: List all published GenAI Maturity Framework whitepapers (CC BY 4.0). Returns titles, subtitles, abstracts, canonical URLs, and Markdown download URLs.

tools.name: list_free_tools
tools.description: List all free interactive tools available at genaimaturity.net — compliance mapper, model comparison, policy generator, governance checklist, agentic readiness, vendor scorecard, prompt library, data readiness, use case generator. Returns names, descriptions, canonical URLs.

tools.name: map_compliance_control
tools.description: Search the AI compliance control mapping across EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and SOC 2. Returns matching controls with per-framework citations.

tools.name: find_use_cases
tools.description: Filter the enterprise GenAI use case catalog by industry, business function, and current maturity level. Returns ranked matches with ROI band, effort estimate, prerequisites, and metrics.
